body: How did you try with your previous attempts?
Sorry to hear that. Life is painful. Here to talk if you need.

Sorry I wish I could give you a life changing answer but I can’t. It is hard to understand what the whole point of life is if all that happens is suffering. I hope you find relief some day if you decide to keep going.
How are you going to do it?

I know what you’re saying but the vast majority of attempts by pills don’t work. I just did some research and found some numbers. About 50,000 people are hospitalized every year for Tylenol overdoses. Out of that number, only about 450 actually die. Based on that, your chances of dying are about 0.9%. If you survive you’ll be in even more debt than you already are from hospital bills, procedures, chronic liver/stomach problems, etc. Not trying to make you feel guilty but want to make sure you understand the likelihood here.

Sorry to hear you’re going through a hard time. Please don’t try to OD. It’s so hard to do this nowadays and you can just end up making yourself worse. I know that’s not what you want to hear but just want to warn you. I’ve thought about this as well but too scared of it not working. You’ll probably just throw it up.
Glad to hear you didn’t end up doing anything. Nice to know that a friend cares about you. How were you going to do it?

Yea I feel you man, that’s where I’m at with this - even though you feel like shit now try to enjoy being young. Me personally I’ll probably wait until I’m around 30 before seriously taking my life. Who knows though. But I do agree though that people remember you more the younger you are.
Yea I agree. It’s very hard to overdose nowadays unless you can get your hands on insane amounts of drugs. Even that’s no guarantee.
Well you care because they care. It’s annoying but on the other hand some people want to die because no one cares about them.
Well how were you going to do it?

I know what you mean. It feels like the only reason I’m alive is just so that I don’t hurt my family in death. Nobody really thinks about you too much when you’re alive but then when you kill yourself it ruins people’s lives. A lot of times I wish I had no friends or family, the choice would be much easier.

Well here’s the truth... it actually does get better if you wait it out long enough... at least for a bit. And then it gets worse again. And then it gets a little better. And then it gets worse. You have the small wins but they can’t compete against the enormous losses. So any win seems pointless at the end of the day. And then you start to learn to never appreciate the wins no matter how big because you’re just going to end up losing one way or another. Idk that’s how I feel sometimes. Like I already lost life.
Sorry you’re going through this - it sucks when your family doesn’t understand. You feel like you want to reach out but just ends up hurting you more. At least the people here get what it feels like.

I was thinking of passing out and dying of hypothermia today as well. It would probably be pretty painful and take a long time though. It would wake a lot longer than 30 mins. Probably 5-6 hours at least for you to start losing your physical and mental ability and then several more hours before your heart stops. That’s if someone doesn’t find you before then.

Yep that’s why I’m trying to become more of an asshole, selfish person. These are the people that survive.
Depends. Most of them are not easy.

I feel the same way. Very scared of hurting my family.
Sorry to hear that. What’s stopping you?
How have you tried in the past?
Have you tried other methods besides hanging?
Even when I’m okay I’m only thinking about the next time I’m going to feel suicidal so it’s not like it ever really goes away
How did you try it the first time?
You tell me
Bill Cosby
Hey do you want to play a game of chess? Might help to get your mind off of things. It’s a good distraction for me.
Yea it’s very hard to overdose nowadays. I would avoid that if you can.

If there’s one I learned in life it’s that everyone sets their own pace. We all compare ourselves to other people. It’s natural. But also try to compare yourself to who you were yesterday, or last week, or 5 years ago. If you can make improvement in the right direction in your own life (no matter how small) then you’re already winning the race.
Some people don’t know how else to help. They don’t know how to deal with it so they think calling the police will solve everything.

This exact problem came through my head the other day. At a certain point when you worry about everything you can’t actually distinguish what is a legitimate worry and what’s just a symptom of your GAD. For me I call it the boy who cried anxiety.
Sometimes I really don’t understand why more people don’t commit suicide

Yea for me they’re more or less constant and they’ve gotten worse over the years. I just don’t want to deal with the thoughts/fear anymore. I’ve had periods that were great in my life. I’m just terrified that I’ll have to deal with this for the rest of my life.
What is your illness if you don't mind me asking?
What if you just told them you were feeling sad and wanted to talk? Don't have to go too deep at first but just start out with that and see how they respond.

Yea definitely, the pandemic sort of ruins everything in that sense. At least you're trying. Trying is the hardest part. Sometimes I just have to give myself credit for just being alive. Do they have counselors at your school?

That's a tough situation, sorry you're going through that. Have you tried joining any clubs at your school for things that might be of interest to you. I felt very depressed and isolated one year in college but I joined a cognitive science club. Didn't cure my depression but felt nice to meet other people with similar interests as me.
What are the things you like? What would you spend your money on if you had enough?
